# rappi-mcp-unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP for personal Rappi (Brazil default). Not Partners.

Install:
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial setup
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial auth --from-header "Bearer …"  (DevTools Authorization)
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial doctor

Stdio (never set RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS in the snippet):
{ "mcpServers": { "rappi": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "rappi-mcp-unofficial"] } } }

Skill (same gates, no MCP client required): skill/SKILL.md
npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial call <tool> --json '{...}'

Default: read-only. Never pays.
Charge only if RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is enabled AND explicit_user_intent is true. Guest tokens cannot charge.
Redacts street, phone, email, last-four.

Read: search/browse (stores, products, catalog, home, feed, recent searches), cart + web cart, addresses + geocode, orders + active + eta/receipt/invoice/status, coupons, checkout preview (no charge).
Gated cart: rappi_add_to_cart, rappi_update_cart_item, rappi_clear_cart, rappi_reorder.
Gated pay: rappi_place_order, rappi_set_payment_method, rappi_cancel_order, rappi_tip_order.
Intent only: logout, address create/update/delete/select, rappi_rate_order.

HTTP optional: loopback 127.0.0.1 + Origin allowlist. Tokens in ~/.rappi-mcp/tokens.json (0600), never in git/tarball.
